regressions.name: ppu-raw-sthu-ra-zero-debug-invariant
regressions.summary: A raw sthu word with RA=0 is an invalid form; the debug executor refuses it with an invariant and a release build executes it.

regressions.name: ppu-raw-lhzu-ra-equals-rt-debug-invariant
regressions.summary: A raw lhzu word with RA=RT is an invalid form; the debug executor refuses it with an invariant and a release build executes it.

regressions.name: ppu-raw-lmw-ra-in-load-range-debug-invariant
regressions.summary: A raw lmw word with RA inside the loaded range is an invalid form; the debug executor refuses it with an invariant and a release build executes it.

regressions.name: ppu-raw-sequence-sthu-ra-zero-debug-invariant
regressions.summary: A raw PPU sequence that reaches sthu with RA=0, an invalid form, trips the debug executor's invariant; a release build executes the form.
